justification: Fixes the AG-W0-5 fail-closed `l5_certification_ref='' ` bug in the structural-proof integrated-runtime regen chains (auditability MW / R1A / R1B). The cert ref was never threaded into several spine contracts in the structural/fixture entrypoints: (1) build_l3_runtime_orchestration_receipt did not accept/forward l5_certification_ref (field existed, default '') — added the param + threaded it; (2) the MW entrypoint did not populate it on the L3 receipt, the ExitReviewPacket.l5_certification_refs, or the L6 RuntimeExhaustBundle — threaded the existing structural-proof constant NATIVE_PROOF_L5_CERT_REF through all three; (3) the integrated_safe_reuse entrypoint's DENY-path X3DenyPacket did not carry the ref the ALLOW path already extracts from the review — threaded review.l5_certification_refs[0]. Also fixed ops_scripts/ci/regen_integrated_runtime_latest.py REPO_ROOT (parents[1]->parents[2]) — stale after the script's relocation from repo-root scripts/ to ops_scripts/ci/, which had broken both its tools.* imports and its config/ data-file paths. No new mechanism, no app-specific literals, no app_id branches; pure cert-ref threading + relocation-path cleanup applying to all apps_* equally. Allowed-with-receipt per .codex/rules/agentic-core-glob-lock.md ('Fixing bugs in generic enforcement'). Authorized by the user (started the l5_certification_ref follow-up task).
value_choice_note: Reused the existing structural-proof constant NATIVE_PROOF_L5_CERT_REF='test:valid:w6' (runtime/bindings/native_contract_chain.py) as the single source for the structural/fixture cert ref, rather than inventing a new literal. verify_certification_ref only enforces non-empty.
